title: Chapter 36: Fast Forward in the Village
content:
Chapter 36:

Fast Forward in the Village

—For Subaru, visiting that village marked his third time doing so in total.

A village he’d visited with Ram the first time, and toured with Rem the second. For a village located right next to the lord’s mansion, its scale was small; the population was around three hundred at most. Far fewer than his local elementary school back in his original world.

Even knowing it was that tiny, to the current Subaru, even a village of that size felt too overwhelmingly large to handle.

Saying “around three hundred” was easy, but going around to investigate every single one of them was impossible. Let alone the fact that, even thinking optimistically, he only had today and tomorrow.

“Even so, you finished your work remarkably early.”

“Barusu was sharp to a creepy degree. Who knows what happened.”

“Heh heh, the sleeping potential within me must’ve finally blossomed. You can praise me straight up without being weirdly shy about it, Ram-chi. Just don’t fall for me!”

His morning work being highly praised, Subaru was quite on cloud nine.

It was the result of pouring all his energy into finishing his mandatory chores to ensure the afternoon shopping trip. Up until now, getting fired up and throwing himself into it like that often resulted in him spinning his wheels, but strangely, this time he must have let go of his tension, allowing him to tackle it naturally.

Naturally, the sensation of Emilia’s lap came to mind, and his ears grew hot.

—I guess she really did help me relax.

Even interacting with the twins, which had previously forced him to put up such a false front, didn’t seem to have that much of a mental toll on him right now.

Though some tension certainly remained, in a good way, it ended up pushing and tightening Subaru’s resolve.

Therefore, strolling through the village with a flower in each hand just as previously stated, Subaru’s state of mind was at least calm enough that “the trembling didn’t start.”

That was partly a matter of his feelings toward facing the two of them, but at the same time, it applied to the tension of acting within the village.

—Because above all else, he had to avoid tipping off the person in question by acting strange.

What he learned from last night's Q&A with Beatrice was the condition for a curse arts user to cast a curse—physical contact with the target.

As a prerequisite for cursing their target, a curse arts user had to make some form of contact, such as touching them, at least once. If one considered a curse arts user to be purely an assassin, this was quite a risky condition.

Thinking about it with the knowledge of his original world, for an act that could be accomplished just by sniping from a distance, they had to take the risk of exposing themselves.

One could say that it was precisely because they paid that price that the absolute fulfillment of the curse upon activation was guaranteed.

In any case,

“The conditions for the culprit haven’t changed—it’s limited to a villager I encountered on both of the two previous times I visited the village.”

And, if that person happened to be an outsider who arrived within the last few days, it was practically a guarantee. Narrowing it down would be easy.

While gazing at the cozy village scenery, Subaru ran his memory at full capacity to scour the past. But no matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t possibly grasp every single person he’d met in the village.

He was suddenly turning the eyes that had been focused inside the mansion to the outside. Because it was a line of thought he had pretty much ruled out, digging through those old memories was a real chore.

“For now, the ones I remember are… the ‘Youth-Restoring Hag’ and the Youth Group. The ‘Ram & Rem Fanclub,’ the ‘Chief,’ the brats, and that’s about it huh.”

Among the villagers, these were the particularly memorable faces.

The “Youth-Restoring Hag” was an old lady with a truly admirable ingrained habit for sexual harassment; her groping Subaru’s butt with a lecherous smile was still fresh in his memory. Apparently, whenever she found a young man, she would sexually harass him and spout nonsense like, “I’m getting my youth back, my youth back.”

The Youth Group was exactly what it sounded like, a group formed by the young men of the village. The leader was a loud, sporty-looking guy with a crew cut, and the way he forcefully slapped him on the shoulder was awfully rough for the indoorsy Subaru.

The ‘Ram & Rem Fanclub’ was just what he called them for convenience; they didn’t actually call themselves that. At a glance, it consisted of members very similar to the Youth Group, led by a crew-cut leader. They apparently didn’t like any guy getting chummy with Ram and Rem, and Subaru had grimaced in annoyance when they repeatedly slapped him on the shoulder as harassment.

And the ‘Chief’ was a short, hunchbacked old man. He was bald on top, but had a distinctive hairstyle with white hair jutting out from the sides like horns. His magnificent beard was also pure white, and combined with his sharp gaze, his appearance gave off the perfect aura of a ‘capable village chief’ kind of villager. He wasn’t actually the village chief, just a person who possessed the dignity of one. Hence, he was given the lukewarm nickname ‘Chief.’ He had a tendency to be hard to deal with, strictly poking at Subaru while saying things like, “Kids these days!”

“Thinking back on it like this… they’re all a bit too suspicious, aren’t they? They’ve all casually made physical contact with me. Out of these four choices… well, practically three choices, though.”

Since choices two and three were functionally integrated, it naturally settled nicely into three options. That being said, that was as far as his materials for judgment went. To delve any deeper, as expected—

“I have no choice but to step into the exact same situation this time too, huh.”

As a conclusion, there was no other way.

Subaru sighed at himself for always only ever finding methods that involved throwing his own body at the problem. Then, at his melancholic sigh,

“Whatcha doin’, Subaru—?” “Does your tummy hurt—?” “Are you hungry—?”

The voices reacting in rapid succession came from above Subaru.

Turning his head, Subaru looked behind him—at the small figures clinging around his back.

It was a boy with neatly trimmed short brown hair. He was under ten years old, probably around the lower grades of elementary school. The boy smiled goofily at Subaru’s gaze. And besides him, small shadows were clinging to Subaru’s legs and waist.

All of them were small children whose heights only reached around Subaru’s waist. Just counting the ones clinging to him, there were four, and looking around, there were roughly up to ten in total.

Readjusting the weight that wasn’t particularly heavy for his trained body, Subaru prefaced with a “Now then,” and said,

“You guys always come pestering me even across time and space, huh…”

“What’re you saying—?” “Did you bump your head—?” “Do you have the runs—?”

“Stop fixating on stomachaches so persistently. What is it with you, do you really want me to have the runs that badly?”

When Subaru said that, the children all burst into giggles at once. Most likely, rather than finding the joke funny, they were just normally reacting to the word ‘runs.’

It seemed that pure toilet humor being the best way to draw roars of laughter from this age group was a universal truth, even after crossing worlds.

“And, my nature of being indiscriminately swarmed by brats hasn’t changed either.”

While getting his cheek pulled by the kid who’d climbed onto his back, Subaru could only drop his shoulders at the cruelty of his own constitution.

It was a contradictory power that countered the absolute loner power born from his communication disorder—a full display of his “Absolute Loner Power (excluding brats).”

“For some reason, I’ve always been pretty popular with kids and old folks. Honestly, I’d be perfectly happy just being popular with one specific person in this world, though.”

He spun his body around, entertaining the kid on his back.

Happy squeals rang out, and while listening to a flurry of voices yelling “Me next, me next!”, Subaru paraded through the village with the children in tow.

Currently, Subaru was acting independently on his own.

In reality, he wasn’t alone, and because he was being clung to from all sides, it was more like restricted action, but in the sense that he wasn’t accompanied by Ram or Rem, he was acting freely.

The maid sisters who had visited the village with him,

“Sister, sister. Let’s split up and just gather the light items.”

“Rem, Rem. Let’s leave the heavy and hard-to-carry things to Barusu.”

Leaving behind remarks that would prove depressing later on, had briskly scattered to do the shopping.

Most likely, it was their way of being considerate toward Subaru, who had said he wanted to see the village, but his true feelings were that he wished at least one of them had stayed behind. If they had, this situation of being swarmed by kids too,

“I wouldn’t have had to do a round of greetings with the suspects while completely stressed out.”

Feeling like he was about to break out in a cold sweat, Subaru voiced his own decision again to confirm its difficulty level.

For the search of the curse arts user, the method Subaru had chosen was incredibly simple.

—To use himself as bait and lure the curse arts user out directly.

That being said, he wasn’t offering himself up going, “Here, please kill me!” He was intending to purposely step into the preceding stage—the stage where the curse’s spell rite would be carved into him.

He was well aware that it was a highly risky decision. Because that meant that if they felt like it, the moment the curse arts user activated the curse, what awaited Subaru would be a countdown to a debilitating death.

A carp that jumps onto the cutting board itself and waits for the chef’s knife to swing down—putting himself in that position was Subaru’s current goal.

To see the face of the unseen chef, which he couldn’t see unless he got on the cutting

board.

“At the very least, Beako said she can unravel the spell rite itself.”

Beatrice, and also Puck, were reportedly capable of breaking the curse’s spell rite. He wanted to avoid the latter since it would naturally involve Emilia, but if Beatrice proved uncooperative, he would have no choice but to resort to that method.

“Subaru— evil face—” “Scary face—” “Weird face—”

“What do you all think you're saying pointing right at someone's mug, dear children?! Plus I've been hearing you here and there for a bit now, number three!”

Throwing in retorts, he dragged the children along as he strolled through the village.

Even if he wanted to separate from them, they wouldn’t let him, and they were also reasonably excellent as navigators for finding his suspects.

Above all, for an assassin who couldn’t afford to cause a commotion in the village, there was no way they could harm Subaru while he was walking around with this many children. Their purpose as meat shields; such calculation.

“I’m pretty wicked myself. I’m put off by my own thoughts.”

“Subaru, what’s wrong—” “Whassamatter—” “Goin’ senile—?”

“Nahh, nothing really.”

Stroking the heads of the children grabbing around both his legs, Subaru laughed self-deprecatingly,

“Well, it’s for the sake of my happiness. Pitch in and help out a little, yeah?”

Now that he thought about it, he’d never really liked kids in the first place.

They were loud, overly familiar, and selfish.

—Maybe he felt that way because they seemed just like himself.

※※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

“Ram came to check on you since your free time was about up, and this is what she sees…”

Running a hand through her pink hair, Ram sighed in exasperation.

Receiving her gaze, Subaru swung his arms in wide circles,

“I’m not doing anything weird, y’know? Oops, my bad, just a sec more. —Aaaand, arm swinging and leg bending and stretching exercise!”

Moving his body freely and dynamically, he thoroughly loosened up his stiff muscles. Imitating Subaru’s movements, the children did the same, and surrounding them, a group of elderly people and the Youth Group could be seen following along a beat behind.

Finally, he took a deep breath, and everyone regulated their breathing together.

Then, as a grand finale, he reached both hands toward the sky, and everyone shouted in unison,

“

—Victory

!!”

Having pulled it off, cheers went up, and he instinctively high-fived the people around him. Wiping his slightly sweaty forehead, he slipped out of the chatting circle and went over to Ram. In stark contrast to Subaru’s refreshing demeanor, Ram directed freezing cold eyes his way,

“And what sideshow is this supposed to be?”

“Sideshow? It’s nothing that exaggerated, y’know. I was just entertaining the rugrats all at once, and the adults watching just got carried away and joined in.”

Radio Calisthenics Part Two was his method for dealing all at once with the noisy kids demanding he play with them, pay attention to them, and acknowledge them. Come to think of it, he had only acted as a mere radio-nist during his very first loop, so he took this opportunity to make it public.

“Well, it was more popular than I expected, which surprised even me. As expected, this feeling of it being widely enjoyable from kids to the elderly is surely the secret to its long-standing popularity, wouldn't you say!?”

“Ram wouldn’t know.”

“She cut me down instantly!”

As Subaru dramatically leaned back at Ram’s curt response, the watching children traced his reaction and leaned back too,

“Ram-chi, so cold.” “Ram-chi, so mean.” “Ram-chi, so scary.”

“…Did you teach these children to call me that?”

“Nahh, it’s not like I intentionally taught them. But approachability is super important, right? If you're too far away, you can't even see the other’s face properly... and I just, thought that sorta thing was lonely... I just, thought—t.”

“You certainly have a glib tongue. Ram doesn’t mind it that much, but Rem might hate that sort of thing.”

“Rem-rin?” “Rem-rin.” “Rem-rin-rin.”

Seeing the children tilting their heads as they chorused that name, Ram shrugged as if she had already given up.

Then she turned back to Subaru,

“So, did you enjoy the village to your heart’s content?”

“—Ah, in that regard, without a hitch.”

Answering Ram’s question, Subaru contorted his cheeks into a smile.

A village stroll, which was in name only for contacting his suspects—that objective itself was easily achieved in a way that surpassed his expectations.

Partially because they were prominent figures to begin with, but mostly because they themselves likely had an intent to make contact with Subaru. They had showed up without him even needing to search for them, so regardless of the flow of events, he made just as much, if not more, physical contact with them as last time.

Though, he paid careful attention to consciously avoid being touched by anyone else, ensuring that no one other than the main named characters surfaced as suspects.

“I really wanted to show you my contortionist skills, completely dodging them by changing tactics and using every trick in the book… Though when surrounded by this many rugrats, there’s nothing I can do.”

He sighed at the children still clinging all over his body. Unlike the adult faction, who generally gave up after being dodged once, the children’s vitality was something he couldn’t hold a candle to.

That being said, with Ram coming to fetch him, it was time to say goodbye to that youth.

Subaru filled his eyes with the reluctance of parting,

“Alright, I’ve got work to do, so get off, you guys. Man, so bummed, what a shame. If I had more time, I would’ve played with you more. Haha, too bad.”

“Stay fresh—” “And keep on smiling—” “Are you really that happy?—”

“Shut up! If you want to be properly played with, you guys need to think about how you treat your elders! Having kids use casual speech with me right off the bat when we first meet makes me realize how objectively low my social stature is, and it’s depressing!”

And then he ended up yelling at kids, keenly realizing his own low social stature once again. It was a negative spiral.

Waving to the pouting children, Subaru followed Ram, who was signaling with her eyes to hurry and meet up with Rem. But right before he started walking, his sleeve was tugged. When he turned only his head, a girl with brown hair in braids was shyly holding him back.

“Oh?”

A voice of surprise instinctively leaked from Subaru.

Unlike the group that had been actively bothering him until now, this girl was the kid who had been sneaking glances at Subaru from a step back.

Crouching down, he leveled his gaze with the downcast girl,

“What’s up? If you have something to say, I’m listening.”

“Umm, you see… over here.”

Tugging his sleeve, the girl pointed in the opposite direction of the meeting spot with Rem.

Feeling bad about shaking off that feeble pulling hand, Subaru looked at Ram as if seeking permission. She gave a small sigh,

“Do as you please for just a little while longer.”

“Aye, I owe you one, Senpai. So then, what is it?”

He followed the girl as she led him by the hand.

With her at the lead, trailing along in a mob were the exact same child members as before. They seemed to know the destination, as they all wore mischievous smiles on their faces, whispering to each other in low voices.

“He’s totally gonna be surprised.” “He’s totally gonna be happy.” “He’s totally gonna pee himself in joy.”

“Being surprised and happy and peeing myself in joy—what am I, an untrained puppy? When my expectations are raised that much, the contrarian in me actually doesn’t want to be surprised…”

Pushed along by the giggling children, they slipped between the houses and entered a sunless corner.

And then, discovering THAT which the children wanted to show him,

“Ah-ah, come to think of it, this event happened too, didn’t it.”

An understanding voice instinctively slipped out, and Subaru clapped his hands, nodding repeatedly.

The girl let go of his hand and broke into a run. The slightly quiet girl panted as she hugged IT in her arms and returned in front of Subaru.

It was a ‘puppy’-like creature with brown fur.

It looked like it had only just been born, its body length wouldn’t even reach thirty centimeters even stretched out completely.

With round eyes and seemingly soft fur, it possessed more than enough charm to stir Subaru’s blood as a fluffist.

His arms started to reach out, ignoring Subaru’s own will, but he somehow managed to restrain them and let out a long breath.

Surrounded and doted on by the children, a pet feeling exactly like a king. However, based on his experiences so far—

“Hssssss!”

“It ends up like this after all, huh…”

The moment Subaru stepped closer, it raised the fur all over its body and intimidated him.

Seeing it make its tiny body as cautious as possible, the children also made surprised faces,

“It’s usually so quiet—” “It’s only mad at Subaru—” “What did you do— Subaru—”

“I’m the one who wants to ask that! For this to happen three times out of three, I wonder if it’s simply a matter of compatibility between me and this little guy.”

While responding to the children’s booing, Subaru tried observing the state of the small animal that wasn’t getting friendly in the slightest.

Unless there was a specific reason, this encounter with the small animal was also his third. Making contact with the exact same individual and getting exactly the same reaction made him feel like looping was actually worth it. For some reason, the loops Subaru experienced rarely let him tread the exact same path as the previous time.

“But honestly, if it’s going to give the same reaction, I’d have been happier if it was a friendly one.”

Being hated three times out of three was genuinely depressing.

Subaru sucked up to it with an ingratiating smile. Then, suddenly, the puppy uncoiled as if dropping its guard. Seeing it curl up in the braided girl’s arms, Subaru eagerly stepped forward, thinking this was his chance.

“Well then, excuse me.”

He poured the fluffing skills he’d leveled up on Puck into the curled-up small animal with all his might.

First, for a preliminary test, he checked the feel of the head and back, then the belly, and attacked the routes preferred by professionals like the tips and bases of the limbs. The ears and tail, his recent personal favorites, he’d save for the second half’s enjoyment.

“Whoa, as expected of a fluffball I’ve even seen in my dreams. Not bad fluff-munication, huh. But stray animals still have a slight issue with their fur texture, as expected. Daily brushing and love are the deciding factors there.”

“I don’t know what Subaru’s saying—” “Fluffball? Fluff-mu—?” “An adult fawning over a puppy is kinda gross—”

“Number three has been completely merciless with every single comment for a while now!?”

The beautiful chestnut-haired boy in charge of being ‘number three’ smiled innocently at Subaru’s retort. If you just cropped that part, he’d be an angel; that must be what made him so conceited.

“Just how many girls is he going to make cry in the future… Be that as it may, fluffing really is the best—it’s the pinnacle of culture created by humanity.”

Having his splintered heart healed by the soft touch, Subaru was captivated by the mysterious charm that fluffing held.

It made sense that things like cat cafes became popular. Originally, thinking from a hygienic standpoint, who could say they’d come up with the fusion of cats and cafes? The inventor must be an exceptionally brilliant fluffist.

“So fluffballs and fluffists are destined to be drawn to each other. Man, I’m poetic. And you are super fantastic. That being said, there are a few concerning spots here and there. Whoops, found a dime-sized… no, penny-sized bald spot on the top of your head. It’s gotten a bit whitish, but where did you bump—Ouch!”

Perhaps having its complex pointed out was the trigger, but the puppy that had been quiet until then suddenly bared its fangs.

Chomp.

 The small canine teeth dug into his left hand, and when he hurriedly pulled away, blood trickled lightly down the back of his hand.

Subaru looked at the wound with an “Aiya~” and said,

“What an insane event completion rate. Even the position of the wound is almost the exact same; are you perhaps time leaping too?”

To the question he asked while lightly wiping the blood-oozing wound, the small animal, whose wariness had completely returned, only gave back a sound of intimidation.

Watching the exchange between one person and one animal where the rift had opened once again, the observing children said,

“Because he got carried away after all—” “I mean, with him touching her all he wanted—” “Besides, this puppy is a girl anyway—”

“I feel like the main point is subtly shifting… and no one is worried about me. It’s about time a tsundere who goes ‘dere’ showed up!”

He said a piece of his mind regarding the children’s attitudes, but not a single one listened. On the contrary, probably because Subaru had raised his voice,

The puppy jolted, wriggled and jumped out of the girl’s arms, and dashed off straight toward the bushes.

“Ahhh~” “Ahhh~” “Ahhh~”

“Finally, you’re all in unison! My bad! I meant no harm! It’s always like this!”

Stomping his feet, he apologized for a good while, and then waved goodbye to the children who said they were going to look for the puppy.

Parting with them, who had grandly left their marks all over Subaru’s body right up to the very end, he hurriedly returned to where he had kept Ram waiting.

“Sorry for the wait.”

The haughty maid who had her arms crossed and her back leaning against the fence. She opened just one eye and directed her gaze at Subaru as he called out to her,

“Regarding the matter of the junior Ram sent off thinking he’d be done soon, returning with messed up hair, wrinkled clothes, and bleeding from his left hand.”

“That’s exactly what I was apologizing for! A lot happened, you can tell just by looking, can’t you.”

“Indeed. Ram was watching, so she knows the gist of it.”

Letting a feeling of sorrow peek through her neat features, Ram let out a small sigh.

Subaru furrowed his brows at her uncharacteristic attitude, but immediately after, Ram scoffed “Hah” through her nose while looking at him,

“Both that wound and your appearance are pathetic, so we’re joining up with Rem right away. Rem should be able to fix both of them.”

“My my~, is Ram-chi the type who can’t use healing magic?”

“Ram can perform a drastic treatment to sever the affected area.”

“That folk remedy is way too dangerous?!”

Subaru couldn’t hide his shudder. Then, Ram suddenly walked up to Subaru, tugged his sleeve, and began to lead the way.

Blinking his eyes at how rare it was for her to initiate contact like this, Ram turned only her head back and said,

“Barusu, aren’t you coming?”

“I’m going, you know? With you.”

When he replied, he saw Ram’s lips soften into a smile for just a fleeting moment.

Just like that, he started walking while being pulled by his sleeve by her.

On one hand, he thought it would be cute if she were always this honest, but on the other, he also thought it was perhaps because she was always so honest with herself that she blurted out only those kinds of remarks.

Honesty, too, depended on the time and the situation.

As he was pondering such things, the two of them, he and Ram, directed their feet toward the place where they had kept Rem waiting.

While the back leading him gave him a sensation as if, for some reason, they were walking slowly, at a more leisurely pace than usual.
